mechanism: Tacrolimus impairs renal potassium excretion through calcineurin inhibition, reducing activity of Na-K-ATPase in collecting duct principal cells, resulting in potassium retention and hyperkalemia risk.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; restrict dietary potassium intake; avoid concurrent potassium supplements unless serum levels are documented low; consider potassium-sparing diuretic alternatives.
